t.p: Please pay the consultation fee before your visit: the waiting room opens once payment is received.

a.style: background-color: #714B67; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 22px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block;
background-color: #00A09D; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold;

div.p:
Before you join:
• Open the link a few minutes early on a phone, tablet or computer with a camera and microphone.
• You will be asked to confirm your identity and will wait in a virtual waiting room until the dentist lets you in.
• Choose a quiet, well-lit place and have your list of medicines and any photos or X-rays ready.
• This link is personal: please do not share it.
Best regards,

div.p: Once confirmed, you will receive a second email with your secure join link and, if the clinic requires it, a link to pay the consultation fee before the call.
You will need a phone, tablet or computer with a camera and microphone. No app is needed: the consultation runs in your web browser.
Best regards,
